identity.title: Pokémon the Series: XY - Limited Edition Collection

leadText:
The Pokémon the Series: XY - Limited Edition Collection is a Region 4 DVD set that was released by in Australia on August 30, 2017. This DVD set is also referred to as the Pokémon the Series: XY Collector's Set in promotional material. Overall, the set includes 18 discs with 141 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7749. 

It contains all of the dubbed episodes from Pokémon the Series: XY. Specifically, it has episodes from Pokémon the Series: XY, Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest, and Pokémon the Series: XYZ.
